title: Such Strange Ores
description: Just a simple more ores mod, nothing too crazy, right? Not your average MCreator mod
body:
# ⚠️WARNING: MAY CONTAIN STRANGENESS!!!
![Mod Banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/bf815f004315bec906f665c4196cbc1984f6bd9a.png)

Such Strange Ores is a simple more ores mod that I made that resembles a lot of more ores mods, except instead of adding the ores that most other modders add, my ores are unique.

**New Ores**

- Tachyonium
- Amethystine
- Ruby 
- Sapphire
- Darmstadium
- Arcandanium
- Argon
- Lutita
- Useless
- Useful
- Oganesson

Outside of those ores, there are also a few new mobs, and a painting, Mountainscapes. but nothing that crazy. I know I usually make dimension mods, but I needed a break, so hopefully you enjoy the ores, some are overpowered, some are not so overpowered, some are weak, things are unbalanced today. Also, don't mishandle Argon, it'll end badly

**New Mobs**

- Serena
- Ore Creeper

There are also plenty of secrets to find, new places to explore, but nothing crazy at all..... or is there????

### ⚠️DO NOT USE IN A WORLD YOU CARE ABOUT, MAY CONTAIN WEIRDNESS!!!

IMPORTANT NOTE: I originally made this mod for april fools day, so don't get mad at me if crazy stuff happens or if you see something that triggers you, only play if you really want chaos
